sweeps.name: topology
sweeps.narrative: Eight single-node TP8 instances are the control every other sweep is read against.

sweeps.name: ep-off
sweeps.narrative: Replicating all 256 experts instead of sharding them should cost KV room and throughput against the EP twins in topology.

sweeps.name: pipeline
sweeps.narrative: Pipeline stages should trail data-parallel shapes of the same width, since each stage adds a boundary hop per decode step.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: At in-node EP width 8 on NVLink the all-to-all backend should matter little.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: fp8 KV should matter most on 8x TP8, whose 80 GiB ranks leave the least KV room (fp8 was +40% there at c=32 in the 8gpu report).

sweeps.name: batch-caps
sweeps.narrative: A seq cap of 32 should bind on 8x TP8 at 512 lanes.

sweeps.name: routing-prefix-cache
sweeps.narrative: prefix-affinity should only beat queue and random with caching on, and eight instances give it the most room to win.

sweeps.name: prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Capping long prefills should trade a little peak throughput for a much lower ITL p99 at saturation.

sweeps.name: pd-ratio
sweeps.narrative: Decode-heavy ratios should win on AgentX, since cached prefixes leave only a short uncached tail to prefill per turn -- and the RoCE handoff taxes the prefill-heavy splits more.

sweeps.name: pd-always
sweeps.narrative: Splitting every request should trail the threshold arms, because a turn with a cached prefix pays a cross-node RoCE handoff for little prefill.

sweeps.name: pd-wide-decode
sweeps.narrative: TP16 decode instances should hold ITL at higher load than TP8 ones, trading batch slots for faster steps.

sweeps.name: pd-pool-engine
sweeps.narrative: A bigger prefill budget should matter on the prefill-light layout and a decode-pool prefill cap on the decode-heavy one.

sweeps.name: pd-decode-cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: Full graph capture on the decode pool should lower ITL by a few percent, with FULL_DECODE_ONLY matching FULL there.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: FULL capture should beat the PIECEWISE default by a few percent, and NONE should collapse.

objective: max output tok/s per accelerator subject to the scenario's SLOs
scope: cluster; worst instance for TTFT and end-to-end gates

recipe.label: AgentX run recipe: 300 s idle-gap cap, 10 warm-up requests per lane, trajectory start 0.25 to 0.75, 3600 s window, 30 s grace, corpus semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126
